title: The Terminal of Kepler Reach
premise: Theo Zhou, a clone of a murdered transit inspector, runs the lonely relay between the warring colonies of Kepler Reach, carrying sealed messages no one trusts anymore. When the derelict ship Meridian returns with its crew aged backward into children who remember their own deaths, Theo realizes the original Zhou was killed for discovering that cryosleep on one colony is being used to erase half its population. Torn between duty to the transit authority that made him and love for Mara, a Meridian survivor whose memories hold the proof, Theo must choose between preserving his own fragile identity and broadcasting the truth. In the end, he sacrifices his inherited memories to wake both halves of humanity, dying as himself rather than living as someone else's echo.
about_author: Gideon Pemberton is a former orbital logistics analyst who spent six years writing technical manuals before turning to fiction. He lives in a coastal town where he repairs lighthouses and insists the two careers are not so different.

chapters.title: The Long Silence
chapters.summary: POV Theo. Establishes Theo's solitary life running messages between Kepler Reach's two estranged colonies, haunted by fragments of his original's murder. He delivers a routine packet to Meridian Station and meets Mara, a dock engineer who treats him like a person, not a copy. Emotional beat: loneliness cracked open by unexpected warmth.

chapters.title: Children of the Deep
chapters.summary: POV Theo. The Meridian returns from a decade-long deep run with its crew transformed into children who speak of their own deaths in perfect detail. Theo recognizes one child's description: it matches how his original died. Emotional beat: dread blooming beneath wonder as the impossible becomes evidence.

chapters.title: What the Original Knew
chapters.summary: POV Mara. Mara decodes her daughter-self's memories and finds coordinates pointing to cryo-vault records on Colony Halcyon. She confides in Theo, and they discover the original Zhou was investigating mass cryosleep erasures when he was killed. Emotional beat: two broken people finding purpose in each other's wounds.

chapters.title: Orders from a Dead Man
chapters.summary: POV Theo. The transit authority orders Theo to quarantine the Meridian children and destroy all recovered data, claiming biohazard protocol. He obeys—almost—and hides one memory shard. His handler, Director Voss, reveals she knew the original Zhou intimately. Emotional beat: loyalty strained until it creaks.

chapters.title: The Vault Beneath Halcyon
chapters.summary: POV Mara. Theo and Mara travel covertly to Halcyon and breach an abandoned cryo-vault holding forty thousand bodies whose neural patterns were wiped mid-dream. Among them, Mara finds her own mother. Emotional beat: grief sharpened into resolve; love against duty takes its first real cost.

chapters.title: Echo Interrogation
chapters.summary: POV Theo. Voss captures them and interrogates Theo using recordings of the original Zhou, forcing him to hear his own voice argue both sides. Voss claims the erasures prevent a genetic collapse—that truth would kill hope. Emotional beat: Theo's identity fractures as he confronts what he might have become.

chapters.title: The Choice of Waking
chapters.summary: POV Mara. Imprisoned aboard Voss's flagship, Mara learns the vaults can be reawakened but only by overwriting the wipe pattern with a compatible mind—one of the Meridian children's restored memories. It would burn out whoever carries it. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into fierce, clear-eyed sacrifice.

chapters.title: Signal Fire
chapters.summary: POV Theo. Theo escapes with the children's help and hijacks the relay array to broadcast the vault evidence to both colonies, shattering the information blockade. Voss scrambles ships; the colonies' fleets converge on Halcyon. Emotional beat: exhilaration curdling into urgency—the truth is loose, but so are guns.

chapters.title: Kepler Reach
chapters.summary: POV alternating Theo/Mara at climax. Over Halcyon, Theo volunteers to carry the restoration pattern through the vault network while Mara holds off Voss's boarding party. As the forty thousand begin waking, Theo's inherited memories dissolve, leaving only what he built himself. Emotional beat: love expressed as letting go.

chapters.title: The Man Who Stayed
chapters.summary: POV Mara, epilogue. Months later, the colonies negotiate under waking eyes, and Mara tends the rebuilt vault station. A quieter Theo—no longer anyone's echo—arrives on the long route, remembering nothing of their first meeting but choosing her again anyway. Emotional beat: bittersweet renewal; memory ends, love begins.
